traceability.notes: Story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION is fully implemented. A dedicated ESLint rule `require-test-traceability` exists with helpers, enforcing: (1) file-level `@supports` annotations in test files; (2) presence of a story reference in `describe` descriptions; and (3) `[REQ-XXX]` prefixes in `it`/`test` names, with safe auto-fix for missing file-level supports and malformed prefixes. Test file detection is configurable and defaults match the story’s directory and extension patterns. The rule supports Jest and Mocha-style APIs (`describe`, `it`, `test`, `context`) and integrates with the plugin’s dynamic loading and recommended/strict configs. Comprehensive RuleTester tests directly reference this story and validate all key behaviors, and all Jest tests pass. User-facing documentation in `user-docs/api-reference.md` describes behavior, options, and examples consistent with the implementation. Cross-story requirements for validating the actual story and requirement references are satisfied by existing rules from dependency stories (valid-annotation-format, valid-story-reference, valid-req-reference), which apply equally to test files. Accordingly, all acceptance criteria and requirements for this story are met.
